notes: DiscoFlate v3.40.0 — command_gate now takes STACKABLE modifier rows in one action: block-all, allow a command through, block/unblock a specific command, disable/resume this range's commands, disable/resume always-on commands, pause/resume timed events, and remove-all. No more chaining three gate actions — and the old event gating tickboxes are converging here. Legacy single-mode command_gate still works.
